classification_definition.actual_defect: Concrete failing behavior or erroneous test expectation supported by later verification.

status_definition.closed: Named evidence closes the narrowly stated item only.

Evidence is synthetic and local: 31 new-module tests and 3 probes pass, full runtime fails 1/errors 16 (adaptation pin mismatches, missing starlette, one missing-evidence expectation). But only two fixed cases are observed, six-port and service-refusal coverage is explicitly not established, and the full suite is red.

Authentication precedes binding; binding reads designated authorities before any effect; execute_proposal detects immutable-intent conflicts and returns outcome_unknown on unresolved entries; mappings cannot change consent; stop is a durable fence and stopped recovery is read-only reconciliation; money and transfer are record-only/unavailable; direct engine entry on a registered root creates no debt or effect. Reply/stop behavior has no supplied test receipt and one recovery-related test fails.

Strict frozen wire models, Protocol ports, host-only factory, finite failure codes, bounded SQLite claim store with schema preflight, per-case budgets and deadlines, and creator-thread ownership are implemented and coherent.
